title: Neurodiversity-Affirming Care, Sensory Support & Systemic Advocacy
description: Parenting Track 4 & Master Tier Competencies: Covers ADHD and executive function scaffolding, sensory-integrated sleep and home environments, educational/IEP/NDIS advocacy, trauma dissociation de-escalation, case conference literacy, and parallel parenting safety plans.
outcomes: Scaffold executive functioning, sensory regulation, and restorative sleep for neurodivergent children and teens
Advocate effectively in school IEP, behaviour support, NDIS, and multi-disciplinary child welfare case conferences
De-escalate trauma-related dissociation or hyperarousal and maintain safe parallel parenting boundaries after DFV
